title: Vector: The Desk Pet From Hell

title: Paranoia: Now Inflatable!
tagline: Okay, so maybe LARPing your way through a paintball course isn't quite Call of Duty. But when Brenda from accounting gets a little *too* into capture the flag, this inflatable bush provides crucial, if slightly ridiculous, cover. Better than explaining welts to HR, right?

title: Caffeinate Your Calculus
tagline: For the adjunct professor grading papers at 5 AM who needs a visual reminder of why they chose this career path. Watch the equations appear as your lukewarm coffee pretends to be hot. Maybe this time, the numbers will add up to a livable wage.

title: Camping Chaos Kit
tagline: For when you want to eat, boil water, and question life choices all at once, this 3-in-1 mess kit is perfect for that one camping trip where you'll inevitably spill ramen on your socks.

tagline: Planning a 'Jaws' marathon in your shark-infested backyard pool? This weatherproof TV shield laughs in the face of saltwater, rogue volleyballs, and existential dread. tagline: TheraBox understands: some weeks, a scented candle just won't cut it. title: Recipes for Ramen Rejects
tagline: So, your microwave privileges got revoked, huh? This cookbook might be the next best thing. Perfect for those evenings when you want to impress a date with something slightly more sophisticated than instant noodles (like, *really* slightly). May not save your social life, but it's a start.

title: Alexa, Play White Noise… Again?
tagline: So, your Tamagotchi collection is now a cacophony of beeps. The solution? Drown it out with Alexa. Perfect for masking the existential dread of digital pet ownership, or convincing your neighbors you're hosting a (very quiet) rave. Just don't ask it to order more batteries... you've been warned.

tagline: So, you're committed to that interpretive dance routine at your cousin's wedding. Excellent. These Beats Fit Pro earbuds promise to stay put even during your most...*expressive* movements. title: Apocalypse-Chic Water Silos?
tagline: Planning a massive indoor garden that requires, say, a thousand gallons of rainwater? Or perhaps you're just *really* committed to winning the next water balloon fight. Either way, these tanks are here to quietly judge your life choices while keeping you hydrated (or well-armed).

tagline: So, you're training for that obscure competitive thumb-twiddling championship? The Halo View tracks your *exertion* (questionable) and sleep (probably needed after all that). title: Coloring: For When Therapy Fails

Perfect for distracting yourself from that mounting pile of unread emails...or the slow, creeping realization that you peaked in college.

Finally, a way to channel that pre-school rage into slightly less destructive behavior. (Helps if you yell "Touchdown!" after each successful kick.)
